units.name: CollectOverlappingObject

units.name: UpdateThresholdContactObject
units.summary: Ignore far-right objects; at X=$50 use persistent contact handling. Otherwise replace the object with a hidden handler and configure drawing-effect slot three.

units.name: InitializeHiddenDrawingObject
units.summary: Install handler nine with hidden Y and configure drawing-effect slot three with scene-local coordinates and selector $84.

units.name: MovePlayerWithOscillatingObject
units.summary: Maintain standing contact while moving between X=$50 and $90. Move player screen X with the platform while contact bit two is set, then refresh player display through the bank-restoring wrapper.

units.name: MoveObjectLeftOrHide
units.summary: On the current camera page check interaction and subtract one from the full world X; hide the object when it belongs to another page.

units.name: UpdateCommandStoppedMover
units.summary: A command arms a countdown. Move toward Y=$95 until the delay expires, stop there, then use the shared offscreen handling when camera progression allows it.

units.name: UpdateHitActivatedOscillator
units.summary: Distinguish valid command hits from rejected contacts. A valid hit installs two-frame artwork and a persistent active state; oscillate Y between $53 and $73, keep linked object eight at a fixed offset, and maintain standing contact.

units.name: ActivateMoverAtSceneValueFive
units.summary: When the shared scene value reaches five, install handler three, flags six and speed $50. The scene value's gameplay interpretation remains unresolved.

At zero, derive a new nonzero delay from camera/random state while preserving upper bits and show the alternate frame.; ReverseObjectAtHorizontalBounds: Select the left or right limit from render-facing bit six. Reverse at the selected boundary, then make the shared one-pixel horizontal step.; CopyObjectWorldXToNextSlot: Copy both world-X bytes to the immediately following object slot.; UpdateLandingEffectObject: Hide at target height. For the special world-page/coordinate cases, emit mapped effect zero and stop motion at the established vertical boundary; interaction uses the common contact path.; UpdateLandingEffectWorldGate: Check the full world page and horizontal thresholds before choosing the mapped scene effect. At the vertical target stop object motion; common contact handling joins this same gate.; UpdateLandingEffectContact: Check staggered interaction, then rejoin the established landing-effect world-coordinate gate.; UpdateThreePartLaunchingObject: A command removes both adjacent parts. Random facing applies during the active phase.; FacePlayerAndUpdateLinkedLaunch: Handle player contact and face toward full player world X.
